page.layout: Two printed columns at the top of the scan: left column continuing down the whole left side of the page; right column, a short block at the top right. Right side below the top band is not printed in this part. Running head centred above; page number at top right.; One column of verse on the right of the scan, with marginal reference marks at the left edge of the column; signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: Húncve fomnum frágere, Donec vltrò iam vigil Ipfa fefe furrigat.
8. Fallor, an mei fonum Sponsi amantis audio? Ecce montium iuga, Colliúmque vertices Ille faltu tranfilit Vnicè charus mihi.
9. Capreis velocior, Hinnulis pernicior Ecce noftris ædibus Adftat ipfe proximus, Et corufcum iam caput Per feneftras exerit:
10. Méq. blandis intuen. Per clathros ocellulis, His falutat voculis. Heus, adefdum amicula Heus, adefdum bellula.
11 En hyems defæuiit, Exulant nunc æthere Pulfa toto nubila:
12. Mille iam coloribus Prata ridént florea: Mille iam garritibus Omne cœlum perfonat: Turtur in fublimium Confidens nunc arborum Ingemiscit frondibus:
13. Nunc fuis extubera Alma ficus grossulis. Iam nouellis palmites Se racemis veftiunt, st fuo virentia
Rara complent balsamo. Heus, adefdum amicula, Heus, adefdum bellula: 14. Heus, mea ô columbula,

page.notes: The right-hand block at the top is a second column; it is placed after the left column in reading order. Lower right of the scan is cut off and not transcribed. Some letters in the verse are doubtful (e.g. "fomnum", "Méq.") due to the scan. Marginal reference marks at the left edge (s, a, t) are not legible enough to transcribe. The right margin has faint marks only. "(mi." at line 17 and "Quæso fed te, fponfe" are as printed; "Miranam venuftuli" is as printed.
